meta.name: Paul
meta.description: At nearly 30, Paul Mirabel has just sold Amazon the recording of his show and a documentary about his life. Problem, he spent more time on his PlayStation than working and has no archival footage. In short, he lied. How far will this bluff take him? And to top it off, a childhood love resurfaces, because problems never come alone…

videos.title: Salam my khoyas
videos.overview: At nearly 30, Paul Mirabel has just sold Amazon the recording of his show and a documentary about his life. Problem, he spent more time on his PlayStation than working and has no archival footage. In short, he lied. How far will this bluff take him? And to top it off, a childhood love resurfaces, because problems never come alone…

videos.title: Baby softens my heart
videos.overview: In search of new adventures, Paul reconnects with Livia, his childhood love. With Dan, he hits a nightclub where he meets Sandra, a professional dancer. Thanks to her, he ends up in a rap music video that goes horribly wrong.

videos.title: Have Fun in Meurthe-et-Moselle
videos.overview: Paul is released from police custody after being arrested on the set of Naza's music video. He draws inspiration from this misadventure and finally finds his creative spark again. As he grows closer to Livia, she invites him to an Eid celebration. But when Paul and Dan head to Moselle to test out some new jokes, they find themselves unwittingly caught up in a dangerous situation.

videos.title: Good Girls Go to Heaven, Bad Girls Go to Ibiza
videos.overview: In the midst of the controversy, Paul is tasked by Sylvain, Livia's fiancé, with keeping an eye on her during her bachelorette party in Ibiza. Paul sees it as an unexpected chance to get closer to her and eagerly accepts. Amid wild parties, misunderstandings, and unexpected encounters, the trip takes an increasingly unpredictable turn.

videos.title: This Is La Paillade
videos.overview: Back in Montpellier for his mother's birthday, Paul finds himself plunged into a world he thought he'd left behind. Between reunions, a Gypsy wedding and one mishap after another, the trip forces him to confront the past. For Dan, it's the perfect opportunity to better understand the man he's filming and enrich his documentary. But as memories resurface, Paul's emotional balance starts to crumble.

videos.title: Crêpe complète
videos.overview: On the day of the premiere of his new show, Paul wakes up more isolated than ever. After a string of blunders that hurt the people who matter most to him, he realizes this defining moment could lose all meaning if he has to face it alone. As the deadline approaches, he embarks on a true journey of redemption to try and reconnect with his loved ones.
